outcome_data_inspected_before_freeze_not: This prereg was frozen before any RV or liquidation outcome statistic was computed. The only prior inspection was metadata/coverage (row counts, null fractions, timestamp ranges, per-coin event counts) required to make the design executable; no target distribution, coefficient, or forecast metric was observed.
repository_name_priority: Two scientific halves reconciled by funding conditioning: (a) does the funding rate condition realized volatility (RV)? (b) does it condition liquidation risk/intensity? This campaign attacks both halves with a two-way (coin + hour) fixed-effects panel on the full frozen panels, which uses within-coin, within-hour variation and therefore does not require the 3 mutually non-overlapping >=127-day contiguous blocks that the time-series frontier reports as unavailable.

primary_panel_fclr001.null_notes: premium is 100% null (NOT_COMPUTABLE_WITHOUT_INDEX_PRICE) and must NOT be used. funding_asof_lag_h is HOURS-SINCE-LAST-FUNDING (values ~1,2,3,...), NOT a funding rate. The signed funding rate is signed_funding.

combined_liquidation_panel.null_notes: fundingRate, abs_fund_pct, notional_usd, rv24h, rv168h are non-null on all rows.

hypotheses.directional_claim: In a two-way (coin + hour) fixed-effects panel on FCLR-001, the coefficient on signed_funding in a regression of next-hour log RV is non-zero and economically material (>= 2% relative effect per 1-SD funding shock).
hypotheses.primary_outcome: next-hour log_rv1h = log(rv1h) shifted one hour forward within coin
hypotheses.predictor: signed_funding (and abs_funding_pct_trail as a sign-blind robustness)
hypotheses.materiality_definition: Implied change in log RV from a +1 sample-SD shock to signed_funding must be >= 0.02 in absolute value. The floor is frozen here and must NOT be relaxed after outcomes are seen.

hypotheses.directional_claim: In a two-way (coin + hour) fixed-effects panel on the hourly-aggregated combined liquidation panel, the coefficient on fundingRate (and abs_fund_pct) in regressions of log(1+liq_count) and log(1+notional_usd) is non-zero and economically material (>= 2% relative effect per 1-SD funding shock).
hypotheses.primary_outcome: log(1 + hourly liquidation count) and log(1 + hourly liquidation notional sum)
hypotheses.predictor: fundingRate (hourly mean of events inside the hour) and abs_fund_pct (hourly mean)
hypotheses.materiality_definition: Implied change in log(1+count) / log(1+notional) from a +1 sample-SD shock to fundingRate must be >= 0.02 in absolute value. Frozen; not relaxed post-outcomes.

models.specification: Two-way fixed-effects (coin + hour-of-day) panel regression estimated by the within (alternating-projection demeaning) transformation. y~ = beta * x~ + e~ where ~ denotes residuals after projecting out coin and hour-of-day fixed effects.
models.hourly_aggregation_rule_half_b: Collapse the event-level combined liquidation panel to (coin, floor-hour) by count of events and sum of notional_usd. Build the COMPLETE hourly grid over each coin's observed span so that zero-event hours are explicit zeros with has_event=False (flagged, not silently fabricated). The funding predictor for an hour is the mean of fundingRate across events observed inside that hour; for zero-event hours the funding rate is carried from the most recent prior in-panel funding observation (forward fill of FUNDING only, never of the outcome), flagged funding_is_ffill=True. If no prior funding exists, the hour is dropped and counted.

inference.secondary_se: Driscoll-Kraay HAC (Bartlett kernel) on the time-series of cross-sectional moment sums h_t = sum_i x_it e_it; lag L = floor(4*(T/100)^(2/9))
inference.tertiary_se: Newey-West HAC on the stacked within-transformed series (same lag rule)
inference.few_clusters_caveat: Only 5 coins in FCLR-001; cluster-robust SE with G=5 is reported but the effective number of clusters is small, so the Driscoll-Kraay / Newey-West time-series HAC SE are the more reliable dependence-robust measures. This caveat is stated in every verdict.
inference.multiple_testing: Holm familywise correction across the pre-registered primary contrasts within each half; raw and Holm-adjusted p-values both reported. Secondary/robustness contrasts are declared but not used to promote.

walk_forward_oos.design: Strictly chronological expanding-window one-step-ahead. At each daily refit origin (00:00 UTC) the model is re-estimated using only data at or before the origin; all hours in the following day are forecast one-step-ahead. No future information enters any forecast origin. The frozen split boundaries are respected as a minimum (train precedes validation precedes test, with the 7-day embargo).

half_a.models: funding-conditioned FE (coin+hour FE + signed_funding) vs no-funding baseline (coin+hour FE only)
half_a.forecast_map: exp(predicted log rv1h) -> variance forecast; smearing not applied because the same monotone map is applied to both arms, so the QLIKE comparison is internally fair
half_a.dm_test: Diebold-Mariano on the daily-mean QLIKE loss differential with Newey-West HAC variance; H0: equal predictive accuracy

half_b.models: funding-conditioned FE (coin+hour FE + funding_rate_mean) vs no-funding baseline (coin+hour FE only)
half_b.metric: QLIKE(notional_actual, notional_forecast); Poisson deviance also reported as a robustness
half_b.dm_test: Diebold-Mariano on the daily-mean QLIKE loss differential with Newey-West HAC variance

regime_cuts: half_a: RV tercile of trailing rv24h (low/mid/high), UTC session bucket (Asia/EU/US)
half_b: UTC session bucket (Asia/EU/US) of the liquidation hour

support_requires: coefficient non-zero under at least the Driscoll-Kraay or Newey-West HAC SE (95% CI excludes 0)
implied effect from a 1-SD funding shock >= 2% relative (materiality floor)
Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 within the declared family
walk-forward QLIKE relative reduction > 0 with Diebold-Mariano not rejecting equal accuracy in the wrong direction
not dominated by a single coin or a single time block

hard_constraints_honored: both frozen panel sha256 asserted in the eval script header before any read
funding_asof_lag_h is hours-since-funding and is NOT used as a rate
no random train/test split; strictly chronological walk-forward
materiality floor 0.02 frozen and not relaxed
observed liquidations kept distinct from modeled boundary breaches
